releases.title: 更新内容 / Update Notes
releases.notes:
- 支持 Medius 盒子 v3.4.2 固件：按官方通知一键更新固件后，CVM 能正常连上盒子，不会再显示找不到盒子；还没更新固件的盒子照常可用 / Supports Medius box firmware v3.4.2: after the one-click firmware update from the official announcement, CVM connects to the box normally instead of reporting that no box was found. Boxes still on older firmware keep working
- 采集卡画面中断时会自动重新连接：采集卡突然不出画面（例如 USB 连线不稳）时，CVM 会自动重新打开采集卡，界面显示「采集卡画面中断，正在自动重新连接」，画面恢复后自动继续，不必再关掉整个 CVM 重开 / The capture card now reconnects automatically when its feed stops: if the card suddenly stops sending video (for example because of an unstable USB connection), CVM reopens it by itself and shows "Capture card feed stopped, reconnecting automatically", then continues once the feed is back — no need to close and restart CVM
- 预览窗口在暂时没有画面时不再显示「未响应」：画面中断期间窗口保持可操作，也可以直接关闭，不会被误以为程序卡死 / The preview window no longer shows "Not Responding" while no new frames arrive: it stays usable and can be closed, so a paused feed no longer looks like a frozen program
- 「捕获方式」改为先选「采集卡」或「摄像头」，再在「采集后端」选 DShow、UVC、美乐威（采集卡）或 DShow、UVC、海康威视 MVS（摄像头）。原本的设置升级后自动对应，不需要重新设置 / "Capture method" now asks for "Capture card" or "Camera" first, then the "Capture backend": DShow, UVC or Magewell for capture cards; DShow, UVC or Hikvision MVS for cameras. Existing settings carry over automatically — nothing to set up again
  - 采集卡选 UVC 时，也能在「进阶画面调整」里设置 X/Y 轴偏移与水平/垂直反转，和 DShow 一样 / With a capture card on UVC, "Advanced image adjustment" now offers X/Y offset and horizontal/vertical flip, the same as DShow
  - 摄像头选 DShow 时，可以调整自动曝光、曝光档位、自动增益与增益；选采集卡时不会改动设备设置 / With a camera on DShow, you can now set auto exposure, exposure step, auto gain and gain; in capture-card mode the device settings are left untouched
  - 梯形（透视）校正现在所有采集卡与摄像头后端都能开启，包括 DShow 与美乐威；默认关闭，关闭时不影响画面与延迟 / Keystone (perspective) correction can now be turned on for every capture card and camera backend, including DShow and Magewell. It is off by default and has no effect on the image or latency while off

releases.title: 自助解绑与下载重试 / Self-service unbind and download retries
releases.notes:
- 修正下载 CVM 失败后，重试其实没有重新连线的问题。以前只要网络抽一下把连线弄断，接下来的三次重试会在同一瞬间全部失败，画面停在「下载失败，请检查网络后重试」，再怎么按都一样。现在每次重试都会重新建立连线，网络只是短暂不稳的话，通常第二次就过了 / Fixed retries after a failed CVM download not actually reconnecting. Previously, once the connection dropped mid-download, all three retries failed in the same instant and the launcher just said "download failed — check your connection", no matter how many times you clicked. Each retry now opens a fresh connection, so a brief network hiccup usually clears on the second attempt

- 修正环境包文件（例如 NDI、语言档）下载没收完时，启动器报成「哈希不符」的问题。那个说法听起来像档案损坏或被改过，其实只是没下载完；现在会明确说是下载中断，而且会自动重试 / Fixed environment-pack files (NDI, language files, etc.) being reported as a "hash mismatch" when the download was simply cut short. That wording made it look like a corrupted or tampered file; it now says the download was truncated, and retries automatically

- 自助解绑的冷却时间会随近期（180 天内）解绑次数变长；冷却中会直接显示何时可以再解绑 / The self-service unbind cooldown grows with the number of unbinds in the last 180 days; while it is active, the launcher shows when you can unbind again

- 自助解绑失败时会说明原因，不再只显示「失败」：卡密或密码错误、尝试太多次（15 分钟后再试）、冷却中，或需要联系客服。需要客服的情况包括：这台电脑也绑着别的账号、账号有风险记录、上一次解绑没有完成 / A failed self-service unbind now says why instead of just "failed": wrong license key or password, too many attempts (try again in 15 minutes), cooldown active, or support needed. Support is needed when the PC is also bound to another account, the account has a risk flag, or a previous unbind did not finish

- 旧版启动器已无法自助解绑，请更新到 1.3.11 / Older launchers can no longer self-unbind; update to 1.3.11

releases.title: 范围内自瞄模式与启动提示 / Aim-in-range modes & clearer startup messages
releases.notes:
- 「范围内自瞄」新增模式选择：可选「衰减」（进入范围后逐渐减弱，4.1.1b4 起的行为）或「暂停」（进入范围时所选轴直接停住，找回旧手感），预设维持「衰减」 / "Aim within target range" now lets you choose a mode: "Decay" (gradually weakens inside the range, the behavior since 4.1.1b4) or "Pause" (the selected axis stops immediately inside the range, restoring the old feel). Default stays "Decay"
- 「枪械识别」：转换模型（.cvm→.cvmcache、.onnx→.engine）之后，「读取模型类别」与「按类别创建武器」不必先跑一次识别就能直接读到类别名 / Weapon recognition: after converting a model (.cvm→.cvmcache, .onnx→.engine), "Read model classes" and "Create weapons by class" can read the class names directly, without first running a detection pass
- 启动失败提示的文案更清楚：不再出现看不懂的内部代号，改为「运行许可不可用 / 快速模式运行许可不可用」等说明，繁体中文也不再出现逐字拼凑的乱码 / Clearer startup-failure messages: the confusing internal code is gone, replaced by plain wording such as "runtime permission unavailable / fast-mode runtime permission unavailable"; the Traditional-Chinese text is no longer garbled

releases.title: 连接稳定性与曲线校准 / Connection stability & curve calibration
releases.notes:
- 连接稳定性提升 / Improved connection stability
- 拟人曲线（ABCurves）的「计数空间校准」重新显示，可以正常填写校准值 / The count-space calibration fields are visible again in ABCurves, so calibration can be completed

releases.title: 启动失败后重试修复 / Clean retry after a failed launch
releases.notes: - 修正 CVM 启动失败后再按一次启动时，启动器没有把状态重置干净的问题。以前这会让重试跳过启动前的登录检查（本该先刷新的登录就这样带进下一次启动），还会在背景对那个已经退出的 CVM 多做一次登录续期——那次续期会占掉你的登录名额，可能让你在别处的登录被挤掉。现在启动失败后的重试和第一次启动一样干净 / Fixed the Launcher not clearing its state when CVM fails to start and you click launch again. Previously the retry skipped the pre-launch sign-in check (carrying a stale session into the next attempt), and a redundant sign-in renewal still fired in the background for the CVM that had already exited — which consumed a sign-in slot and could push out your session elsewhere. A retry after a failed start is now as clean as a first launch

releases.title: 授权模型下载进度、瞄准区域与 TRT 后台整备 / Model download progress, aim zones & background TRT build
releases.notes:
- 下载授权模型时，主界面右下角会出现进度浮窗，显示服务器加密进度与下载百分比，下载完成后自动消失；面板仍会在开始下载后关闭，但不再看不到进度 / Downloading an authorized model now shows a progress card in the bottom-right corner of the main window with the server-side encryption stage and the download percentage, and it disappears on its own once finished; the panel still closes when the download starts, but progress is no longer invisible
- 下载状态说明改为如实描述：没有人排在前面时显示「服务器正在为你加密专属模型」（每位买家拿到的是独立加密的文件），只有真的有人在排队时才显示前面还有几人 / Download status now says what is actually happening: when nobody is ahead of you it reads "the server is encrypting your personal copy" (every buyer receives an individually encrypted file), and it only shows a queue position when someone really is ahead
- 控制台不再被重复的排队消息刷屏，只在状态变化时输出，等待期间每 15 秒补一条并显示已等待时间 / The console is no longer flooded with repeated queue messages: it prints on state changes only, plus one heartbeat every 15 seconds showing how long you have been waiting
- 「正在准备 TRT 引擎」面板新增「背景运行」按钮：按下后面板收起，进度改在右下角的小卡片上继续显示，点击卡片可随时把面板叫回来；整备本身不受影响，首次生成引擎时不必再全程盯着一个挡住画面的窗口 / The "Preparing TRT engine" panel now has a "Run in background" button: the panel folds away and progress continues on a small card in the bottom-right corner, and clicking the card brings the panel back at any time. Preparation itself is unaffected, so a first-time engine build no longer requires staring at a window that blocks the screen
- 枪械识别模型转换 TRT 引擎时，右下角同样会显示进度卡片与已耗时；以前这个过程没有任何提示，看起来就像卡住了 / Converting the weapon-recognition model into a TRT engine now shows the same bottom-right progress card with elapsed time; previously this step gave no indication at all and simply looked frozen
- 枪械识别模型现在会在启动前就转换成 TRT 引擎，并且与瞄准模型同时进行，两个模型各有一个进度卡片；等待时间不再是两者相加，而且不会再等进游戏后才开始转 / The weapon-recognition model is now converted to a TRT engine before startup, in parallel with the aim model, each with its own progress card. The wait is no longer the sum of the two, and conversion no longer starts only after you are already in game
- 授权模型面板新增筛选：可按作者、输入尺寸、YOLO 版本筛选，并显示「显示 N / M」；每个模型会显示输入尺寸与 YOLO 版本 / The authorized-models panel can now be filtered by author, input size and YOLO version, with a "showing N / M" counter; each model now lists its input size and YOLO version
- 在 /models 购买的付费模型现在也会出现在「授权模型」面板，下载的是专属于你账号的加密文件；海外线路连不上或太慢时会自动改走国内线路 / Paid models bought on /models now appear in the authorized-models panel and download as a copy encrypted for your account only; if the overseas route fails or is too slow it switches to the domestic route automatically
- 授权短暂中断（网络抖动、服务器重连）不再让 CVM 自己停止；因授权中断而停止的运行会在授权恢复后自动继续；修复授权中断一次之后，每次按「启动」都卡在 10% 的问题 / A brief authorization interruption (network hiccup, server reconnect) no longer stops CVM on its own; a run stopped by an interruption resumes automatically once authorization is back; fixed Start getting stuck at 10% every time after one interruption
- 新增「瞄准区域」：可在目标上画多个圆并给每个圆设定落点概率（合计 100%），可按类别单独设置，预览中可显示；默认关闭，关闭时瞄准行为与以前完全相同 / New "Aim Zones": draw several circles on the target and give each a hit probability (totalling 100%), optionally per class, with an on-preview overlay. Off by default, and aiming is unchanged while it is off
- 瞄点模式新增「范围自由」：准星在瞄准点到范围终点之间时不再被 Y 轴拉回，出界才拉向最近的边缘；预览中以绿色标出这段范围 / New aim-point mode "Range (free)": while the crosshair is between the aim point and the end of the range it is no longer pulled back on the Y axis, and it is only pulled to the nearest edge once outside; the range is shown in green on the preview
- 「范围内暂停」改为强度衰减曲线：可设最低强度与曲线弯度，越靠近范围中心越弱，并可在预览中画出范围与即时强度。注意：默认值下范围内的强度会随离中心的距离线性变化，不再是整轴完全暂停，升级后请确认手感 / "Pause within range" is now a strength falloff curve with a minimum strength and a curve shape, weaker toward the centre of the range, and the range and live strength can be drawn on the preview. Note: with the default values the strength inside the range now scales linearly with distance from the centre instead of fully pausing the axis, so please check the feel after updating
- ABCurves 曲线新增手感调整：「拟人步长」「最小整形距离」「整形强度 %」与「X/Y 分开步长」；默认值与以前相同 / ABCurves gains feel controls: humanized step size, minimum shaping distance, shaping strength % and separate X/Y step sizes; defaults behave exactly as before
- CS2 压枪新增 9 把枪：MP9、MAC-10、MP7、MP5-SD、P90、PP-Bizon、M249、SG 553、CZ75-Auto；以前 GSI 识别到这些枪时实际播放的是 AK47 的弹道 / CS2 recoil control adds 9 weapons: MP9, MAC-10, MP7, MP5-SD, P90, PP-Bizon, M249, SG 553 and CZ75-Auto. Previously, when GSI reported one of these guns, the AK47 pattern was played instead
- 没有按住开了识别的 AimKey 时，压枪不再丢失当前武器、退回全局设置 / Recoil control no longer loses the current weapon and falls back to the global settings when the AimKey that has weapon recognition enabled is not held
- 枪械识别：类别名称直接从模型读取并显示；.onnx 转换过一次后自动改用生成的 .engine，不再每次重建；只转换枪械模型时不再弹出瞄准模型的面板 / Weapon recognition: class names are now read from the model itself; once an .onnx has been converted it switches to the generated .engine instead of rebuilding every time; converting only the weapon model no longer opens the aim-model panel
- 准星找色新增「准星中心」算法，适合红点／全息镜（中心点发白过曝也能补上）；新增「X 轴生效／Y 轴生效」开关；HSV 色相范围可以跨过 0／180（例如红色 170→10）；设置不兼容的算法组合时会显示提示 / Crosshair color detection adds a "Reticle center" algorithm for red-dot and holographic sights (it still works when the centre dot is overexposed), separate "affects X / affects Y" switches, HSV hue ranges that wrap past 0/180 (e.g. red 170→10), and a warning when the chosen algorithm conflicts with other settings
- 新增「开枪 Y 输出生效时暂时解除 Y 轴遮罩」选项（默认开，与以前相同）；现在开枪 Y 输出放大（如 120%）时也会按此选项放开遮罩，以前只有缩小时才会 / New option "Release Y-axis mask while fire Y output is active" (on by default, same as before); it now also applies when fire Y output is amplified (e.g. 120%), where previously only reductions released the mask
- 压枪开关键与触发键只能选输入硬件上的按键，另外可加硬件键盘键与组合键；旧设置里选了本地键的这两个键会被重置为「无」，请重新设置 / The recoil toggle key and trigger key now only accept keys from your input hardware, plus hardware keyboard keys and key combos; if either was set to a local key it is reset to None, so please set it again
- 近目标自动点击新增调试预览：每个框标出当前高度与门槛，达标绿色、未达红色 / Near-target auto click adds a debug preview that labels each box with its measured height against the threshold, green when met and red when not
- 主页参数快捷砖的指示灯会按功能是否真正生效显示绿／黄，GSI 阵营分类没生效时会说明原因 / The indicator dot on the home-page parameter tiles now turns green or yellow depending on whether the feature is actually in effect, and GSI faction classification explains why when it is not
- 支持 Medius v3.4.0 与 v3.4.1 固件，盒子更新固件后仍能连上，未更新的旧固件也继续可用；执行器页新增 Medius「渲染器模式」（关闭／仅注入／完全渲染） / Supports Medius v3.4.0 and v3.4.1 firmware, so the box still connects after a firmware update while older firmware keeps working; the actuator page adds a Medius "render mode" setting (off / injected only / full)
- 新增 MAK 执行器（mak-suite 硬件），端口与波特率可自动检测，支持键盘输出与硬件按键监听 / New MAK actuator for mak-suite hardware, with automatic port and baud-rate detection, keyboard output and hardware key monitoring
- Oso 控制器固件：手柄按键可以当作 AimKey 使用（PS 手柄的 L2/R2 可用，Xbox 的 LT/RT 固件不回报） / Oso controller firmware: gamepad buttons can now be used as an AimKey (PS L2/R2 work; Xbox LT/RT are not reported by the firmware)
- 推理运行中也可以使用 Ferrum 串口的「测试连接／测试移动」 / "Test connection / Test move" for a Ferrum serial device now works while inference is running
- OBS UDP 采集：游戏占满 CPU 时丢帧与花屏减少，统计中会显示被覆盖与损坏的帧数 / OBS UDP capture drops fewer frames and shows fewer corrupted images when the game saturates the CPU, and the stats now count overwritten and damaged frames
- OBS NDI 采集：修复初始化成功却一直收不到画面的问题（常见于先用过 UDP/TCP 再切到 NDI）；来源可以只填「OBS」或填 OBS 电脑的 IP；自动搜索会优先选 OBS 主输出而不是预览输出，搜索不再卡住很久；只接收画面，不再接收音频 / OBS NDI capture: fixed connecting successfully but never receiving an image (common after switching to NDI from UDP/TCP); the source can simply be "OBS" or the IP of the OBS PC; auto search now prefers the OBS program output over the preview and no longer hangs for a long time; only video is received, no audio
- 启动器会自动补上 NDI Runtime，双机（OBS 在另一台电脑）也不用再自己安装 NDI Runtime / The launcher now supplies the NDI Runtime automatically, so dual-PC setups (OBS on another computer) no longer need to install it separately
- 数据收集：三个「只在…时」都不勾时改为不设限全部收集，不再一张都不存 / Data collection: with all three "only when…" options unchecked it now collects everything without restriction instead of saving nothing
- 修复参数页栏位内容过长时最后一行被裁掉、也无法滚动的问题 / Fixed the last row of a settings column being cut off, with no way to scroll to it, when the content was too long
- 英文界面：没有整句翻译时改为按子句翻译，减少拼接出的错误英文 / English interface: when there is no full-sentence translation it now translates clause by clause, reducing broken word-by-word English

releases.title: 加速器与代理提示 / Accelerator & proxy guidance
releases.notes: - 当加速器、代理或 VPN 挡住连线时，提示会直接告诉你关掉它；以前这种情况会显示「服务端暂时不可用，请稍等几分钟」，等多久都不会好 / When an accelerator, proxy or VPN is blocking the connection, the message now tells you to turn it off. It used to say "the service is temporarily unavailable, please wait a few minutes", which never got better no matter how long you waited

releases.title: 登录稳定性改善 / Sign-in reliability
releases.notes:
- 登录页连不上认证服务时不再卡死：以前只能关掉启动器重开，现在会自动重试几次，也可以直接再按一次登录 / The sign-in page no longer gets stuck when it cannot reach the authentication service: it used to require closing and reopening the launcher, and now it retries on its own a few times, or you can simply press sign in again
- 查询订阅状态失败时，显示的是真正的网络错误代码，不再显示一个会让人以为要重新登录的代码 / When checking your subscription status fails, the launcher now shows the actual network error code instead of one that suggests signing in again
- 多人同时登录时不再互相挤掉：登录会优先走一条各自独立的通道，连不上才退回原本的方式，整个过程自动完成，不需要任何设置 / Signing in no longer knocks other users offline when many people sign in at once: the launcher now prefers a connection of its own and falls back to the previous route only if that fails, automatically and with nothing to configure

releases.title: 参数页重构与武器识别 / Parameter page rework & weapon recognition
releases.notes:
## 4.1.0 更新内容 / Update Notes

- 参数页改为三层级联显示（武器 / 类别 / AimKey），新增「辅助能力」一行只显示当前已开启功能的开关，并新增武器类别管理（新增、改名、删除、指定成员、合并或分开）/ Reworked the parameter page into a three-level cascade (weapon / category / AimKey) with a new "assist abilities" row that only shows switches for currently enabled features, plus weapon-category management (add, rename, delete, assign members, merge or split)
- 新增武器类别层，可将整类武器集中在一处调参，生效顺序为「武器 → 类别 → AimKey 基准」 / Added a weapon-category tier so a whole class of weapons can be tuned in one place, applied as weapon → category → AimKey baseline
- 武器识别新增「屏幕文字（OCR）」来源，直接读取画面上的武器名称并模糊比对，未被采样或训练过的武器也能识别，武器库可跨游戏共用 / Weapon recognition can now read the on-screen weapon name via OCR and fuzzy-match it, so weapons that were never sampled or trained can still be recognized and the weapon library can be shared across games
- 武器识别新增独立 YOLO 模式，可通过模型类别映射到枪械设置，并支持「按类别创建武器」一次为模型所有类别建立并回填武器条目；原有的模板匹配模式继续保留 / Added an independent YOLO mode for weapon recognition with model-category mapping to weapon settings and a "create weapons by class" action that builds and back-fills entries for every model class at once, while retaining the existing template-matching mode
- 枪械识别的开关统一改由共享枪械识别窗口的「识别方式 = 关闭」承担，只在一处决定是否启用 / Unified the weapon-recognition on/off switch into "recognition method = off" in the shared weapon-recognition window so it is decided in one place
- 目标检测新增「检测模型」按钮，直接读取模型文件并报告架构、规模、输入尺寸与类别，避免选错模型版本却毫无提示 / Added an "inspect model" button on target detection that reads the model file and reports its architecture, scale, input size, and classes, so you no longer silently pick the wrong model version
- 新增「YOLOv5 行式」模型族，支持输出被改成 [N, 5+nc] 布局的模型 / Added a "YOLOv5 row-format" model family for models whose output was changed to an [N, 5+nc] layout
- 优化云端模型下发：每位买家的独立模型文件、排队状态、授权有效期与状态显示；下载新增进度条并会在主窗口状态栏同步显示，开始下载后自动关闭面板；新增下载位置设置（可手动输入或选择文件夹），下载文件名更易读，重复下载会替换旧文件 / Overhauled cloud model delivery: independent model files per buyer, queue status, authorization validity periods and status display; downloads now show a progress bar mirrored in the main window status bar and close the panel automatically once started; added a download-location setting (manual path entry or folder picker), more readable filenames, and repeated downloads replace the old file
- 修复「授权模型」列表为空、模型下载完成后仍显示未下载，以及模型准备中导致列表解析失败的问题 / Fixed empty authorized-model lists, completed downloads still showing as not downloaded, and list parsing failures while models were being prepared
- 新增参数云存储，登录其他电脑后也可以恢复已保存的参数 / Added cloud parameter storage so saved parameters can be restored on another computer after login
- AimKey 支持独立参数范围；新增 Y 轴物理遮罩、开火后暂停目标跟踪时间，以及按队伍切换 GSI class / Added independent parameter ranges for each AimKey, a Y-axis physical mask, post-fire target-tracking pause time, and team-based GSI class switching
- 新增「智能反应时间」，为每个 AimKey 提供更拟人的首次反应延迟及进阶参数 / Added a "smart reaction time" option for a more human-like first-reaction delay per AimKey, with advanced parameters
- 新增压枪 FOV 跟随，压枪时可跟随准星 FOV 中心，X／Y 可分别开关并设定比例与最大位移 / Added recoil FOV-follow so recoil can track the crosshair FOV center, with independent X/Y toggles, ratios, and a maximum offset
- 压枪新增触发键绑定，支持两键组合（同时按住两键才触发）/ Added a bindable trigger key for recoil, including two-key combos (both keys held to trigger)
- 触发前延迟支持按枪械独立设置，避免修改一把枪械影响其他枪械 / Pre-trigger delay can now be configured independently for each weapon
- 扳机的稳定判定、不锁 Y、开火后暂停等时序新增随机抖动，动作更自然 / Added random jitter to trigger timings (stability check, no-lock-Y, post-fire pause) for more natural behavior
- 新增「开火 Y 轴输出%」与开火 Y 轴输出延迟（可加随机量），开火时可按百分比缩放并延后目标跟踪的 Y 轴输出 / Added a "Fire Y-axis output %" and a fire Y-axis output delay (with optional randomization) to scale and defer target-tracking Y-axis output while firing
- 移除「长按左键解锁 Y 轴」功能 / Removed the "hold left mouse button to unlock Y-axis" feature
- 杂项页新增自动急停总开关，附加按键可分别设定延迟与重复冷却 / Added an auto emergency-stop master switch on the misc page, with per-key delay and repeat cooldown for its extra keys
- 推理加强新增一档模式，让控制回圈随推理一起加速 / Added an inference-boost mode that speeds up the control loop together with inference
- 新增 ABCurves 曲线模式和 Oso MAKCU Controller 手柄盒支持 / Added ABCurves mode and support for the Oso MAKCU Controller device
- 新增鼠标反转，并支持分别调整准星找色的 X/Y 范围 / Added mouse inversion and independent X/Y range adjustment for crosshair color detection
- 数据收集支持独立收集枪械识别画面，并可分别设置触发条件、冷却时间、自动标注和类别筛选范围 / Data collection now supports separate weapon-recognition captures with independent trigger conditions, cooldowns, auto-labeling, and category-filter scopes
- 按键遮罩的可选按键补上参数组切换键 / Added parameter-group switching keys to the button-mask candidate list
- 状态悬浮窗显示模式改为「简易 / 进阶」，每项功能可分别选择是否显示，并修正「面板显示开启、实际未运行」的状态不一致 / Changed the status overlay to "simple / advanced" modes with per-feature visibility, and fixed cases where the panel showed a feature as on while it was not actually running
- 曲线页面重新排版让曲线预览不再被压扁，并修复参数页三栏卡片互相挤压的版面 / Reorganized the curve page so the curve preview is no longer squeezed, and fixed the parameter page's three columns squeezing each other
- 细化启动失败提示：VPN/代理、服务暂不可用、系统时间、设备绑定、授权码归属、订阅、模型到期、版本过旧等原因分别说明，且各有独立错误代码，不再统一显示为无法识别的原因，联系客服时可直接提供代码快速定位 / Startup failures now report a specific reason — VPNs/proxies, unavailable services, system time, device binding, license ownership, inactive subscriptions, expired models, outdated versions — each with its own error code instead of a single generic "unrecognized reason", so you can give the code to support for faster diagnosis
- 启动推理时会回报一次使用设置和硬件信息，用于后续优化；回报失败不会影响使用 / Inference startup reports usage settings and hardware information once for future improvements; a failed report does not affect usage
- 修复 RCS 参数保存后重新打开不显示已保存枪械的问题 / Fixed saved RCS parameters not showing the saved weapons after reopening
- 修复重新打开武器映射后压枪可能被自动开启的问题 / Fixed recoil control potentially being enabled after reopening weapon mapping
- 修复全局脚本可能自动切换回上一脚本的问题 / Fixed the global script potentially switching back to the previously selected script
- 修复移动输出百分比接近开关而非按比例缩放的问题（原本 50% 以上等于 100%、以下等于 0）/ Fixed the movement-output percentage behaving like an on/off switch instead of scaling proportionally (previously above 50% acted as 100% and below as 0)
- 修复 CS2 中不带后缀的 m4a1 被误判为 M4A1-S 的问题，现按 CS2 规则识别为 M4A4，压枪轨迹不再对不上 / Fixed CS2 treating the suffix-less m4a1 as the M4A1-S; it is now recognized as the M4A4 per CS2's naming so the recoil pattern matches
- 修复枪械识别「从画面框选」可能取到预览窗尺寸而非采集卡分辨率，以及勾选「显示识别预览」开不出窗口的问题 / Fixed weapon-recognition ROI selection sometimes capturing the preview-window size instead of the capture-card resolution, and the recognition preview window failing to open
- 修复 CPBOX-new 强制按键发送了设备不支持的指令：左右键强制覆写恢复正常，中键和侧键会明确提示不支持 / Fixed CPBOX-new forced button overrides sending commands the device does not support: left/right overrides work again and middle/side buttons now report as unsupported
- 改善 NET API 扳机开火异常的处理 / Improved handling of NET API trigger-firing issues
- 改善 RCS、扳机、武器识别、AimKey、GSI、控制器和曲线设置的保存与显示 / Improved saving and display for RCS, trigger, weapon recognition, AimKey, GSI, controller, and curve settings
- 改善控制器、Medius、曲线控制、登录和模型下载的稳定性 / Improved the stability of controllers, Medius, curve control, login, and model downloads

releases.title: 登录、续费与连线修复 / Login, renewal & connection fixes
releases.notes:
## Launcher 1.3.5 更新内容 / Update Notes

- 密码输入错误时会直接显示密码不正确，不再显示「请稍后重试」/ When the password is wrong, the launcher now says so directly instead of showing "please try again later"
- 兑换授权码成功不再被误报为失败，避免同一组授权码被重复兑换 / A successful license redemption is no longer reported as a failure, so the same key is not submitted twice
- 没有订阅或订阅已到期的账号，可以直接在登录页储值和续费，不必先找客服 / Accounts with no subscription, or with an expired one, can now top up and renew directly on the sign-in page without contacting support
- 自动修复被防火墙拦截的连线：在 Windows 网络提示中按过「取消」所留下的拦截规则，会在登录前清除 / Connections blocked by the firewall are repaired automatically: block rules left behind by choosing "Cancel" in the Windows network prompt are cleared before signing in
- 启动时自动校正系统时间，避免时钟偏差导致连线失败 / The system clock is corrected automatically at startup, so clock drift no longer breaks the connection
- 启动失败的提示更准确，连线被拦截时不再提示重新安装 / Startup failure messages are more accurate and no longer suggest reinstalling when the connection is the thing being blocked

## Launcher 1.3.4 更新内容 / Update Notes

- 修复登录后隔一段时间才启动会失败的问题：启动前会自动刷新登录状态，不再需要重新登录 / Fixed launch failures when starting a while after signing in: the sign-in is refreshed automatically before launch, so signing in again is no longer needed
- 注册时密码被判定为已泄露时，会直接说明需要更换密码，不再显示「请稍后重试」/ When a password is rejected as leaked during registration, the launcher now says to choose a different password instead of showing "please try again later"

releases.title: 错误提示重做 / Reworked error messages
releases.notes:
## Launcher 1.3.3 更新内容 / Update Notes

- 重做错误提示，不再直接显示难以理解的英文原文；支持简体中文、繁体中文和英文 / Redesigned error messages so difficult-to-understand raw English is no longer shown directly; Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English are supported
- 为错误增加唯一代码和复制按钮，方便客服快速定位问题 / Added a unique code and a copy button for each error to help support locate issues quickly
- 修正误导性的配置文件删除提示，并区分登录过期与设备绑定问题 / Fixed misleading instructions to delete configuration files and separated expired-login issues from device-binding issues
- 区分服务端故障与本机可处理的问题，并明确提示 VPN、代理、加速器、系统时间、磁盘空间和 VC++ 运行库等处理方式 / Separated service-side failures from issues that can be fixed locally, with clear guidance for VPNs, proxies, accelerators, system time, disk space, and the VC++ runtime
- 区分 429 限流与 IP 白名单问题，显示更准确的处理建议 / Separated 429 rate-limit errors from IP allowlist issues and provided more accurate guidance
- 检测到 CVM 被防病毒软件删除时，会提示将 Launcher 目录加入白名单 / When CVM is removed by antivirus software, the launcher now suggests adding the Launcher directory to the allowlist
- 新增磁盘空间预检，避免下载到中途才因空间不足失败 / Added a disk-space pre-check to prevent downloads from failing late because of insufficient space
- CVM 启动超过 90 秒仍无响应时会提示，但不会中断正在进行的启动 / Added a notification when CVM has not responded after 90 seconds without interrupting the ongoing startup
- 细化硬件绑定、授权码归属、模型到期和版本过旧等启动结果提示 / Added specific startup messages for hardware binding, license ownership, expired models, outdated versions, and related states
- 错误记录会在下次登录时自动上报，内容不包含密码、授权码或服务器地址 / Error records are reported automatically at the next login and do not include passwords, license keys, or server addresses

releases.title: 推理与配置 / Inference & configuration
releases.notes:
## 4.0.6 更新

- 修复部分 FPS Drop 及推理帧率统计相关问题
- 优化推理循环与帧率计算，降低运行中断风险
- 增强启动失败、DLL 加载失败、授权失败及配置文件错误的诊断日志
- 改善部分崩溃、闪退及授权失效后的处理流程
- 在「杂项」新增可开关的「推理增强」功能，并支持设置推理 FPS 上限
- 在「杂项」新增 FOV 形状选择：圆形 FOV、方形 FOV
- 新增 CVM 启动后自动开始推理功能：仅在 Discord 已登录时执行，支持设置启动延迟
- 优化模型来源切换及本地模型 / CVM 模型显示
- 增加执行成本与推理状态记录，方便分析不同设置造成的 FPS 下降
- 新增配置分享码：可复制当前配置并生成分享码，也可粘贴分享码快速应用配置；分享码不会覆盖本地模型路径、串口、网络设备等硬件相关设置
- 优化配置读写速度：增加针对性读取，UI 语言等简单字段不再完整重载全部配置；使用临时文件及原子替换，降低配置写入中断导致文件损坏的风险

## 4.0.6 Update

- Fixed some FPS drop and inference FPS statistics issues
- Optimized the inference loop and FPS calculation to reduce the risk of runtime interruptions
- Enhanced diagnostic logs for startup failures, DLL loading failures, authorization failures, and configuration errors
- Improved handling of crashes, unexpected exits, and authorization failures
- Added a toggleable Inference Boost feature under Misc, with a configurable inference FPS limit
- Added FOV shape selection under Misc: circular FOV, square FOV
- Added automatic inference startup after CVM launches: only runs when Discord is already logged in, with a configurable startup delay
- Optimized model source switching and local model / CVM model display
- Added execution cost and inference status logging to help analyze FPS drops caused by different settings
- Added configuration share codes: generate a share code from the current configuration, or paste one to apply it quickly; share codes will not overwrite hardware-related settings such as local model paths, serial ports, or network devices
- Optimized configuration read/write speed: added targeted configuration loading so simple fields such as UI language no longer require reloading the entire configuration, and used temporary files with atomic replacement to reduce the risk of configuration corruption caused by interrupted writes

releases.notes:
### 修复内容
- 修复后处理神经网络导致的延迟问题
- 将轴屏蔽调整为每个按键独立控制
- 修复目标离开 FOV 后轴屏蔽未自动解除的问题
- 新增可调节的单次最大移动限制（`0` = 无限制）
- 修复准星找色模式下多颜色配置无法保存的问题
- 修复更多英文翻译错误
- 新增采集卡缓存大小调节功能（`32MB ~ 128MB`）

### 采集卡缓存说明
- 较小缓存：延迟更低，但更容易出现掉帧
- 较大缓存：更能抵抗短暂卡顿，但可能增加延迟
- 修改后需要重启推理程序生效
- 默认值：`64MB`

### Changes
- Fixed latency caused by the post-processing neural network
- Changed axis masking to be handled independently for each key
- Fixed an issue where axis masking would not automatically release after the target left the FOV
- Added an adjustable maximum movement limit per step (`0` = unlimited)
- Fixed an issue where multiple color selections could not be saved in Crosshair Color Detection mode
- Fixed additional English translation errors
- Added capture card buffer size adjustment (`32MB ~ 128MB`)

### Capture Card Buffer Notes
- Smaller buffer: lower latency, but more likely to drop frames
- Larger buffer: more resistant to brief stutters, but may increase latency
- Restart inference after changing the setting for it to take effect
- Default value: `64MB`
